summary: Tuya Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return for routine share changes on May 14-20, 2026, comprising minor employee share option exercises (5,000 and 15,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.00005 per share) under the 2015 Equity Incentive Plan. No tender offer, acquisition, restructuring, or other special situation is involved. The filing reflects standard capital maintenance and equity incentive administration. There are no deal terms, premium, or strategic shift; thus, it is a routine current report not constituting a special situation.
